measurementPeriod.note: The ruleset cannot produce a first event before bar index 200 (EMA(200)); the measurement period is therefore the full cached span minus that warm-up.

assumptions.fillHeadline: entry at the NEXT bar's open, ASK for a long / BID for a short; exits at the opposite side. No look-ahead.
assumptions.fillOptimistic: entry at the trigger bar's CLOSE (mid), exits at the exit bar's close (mid) — labelled OPTIMISTIC UPPER BOUND, not achievable.
assumptions.fillZeroCost: same timing as headline (next-bar open) but at MID on both sides, so the spread drag is visible.
assumptions.intraBarAmbiguity: if a bar touches both stop and target, the STOP is counted first.
assumptions.gaps: a bar opening beyond the stop fills at that bar's open (worse than the stop); a bar opening beyond the target fills at that bar's open (better than the target).
assumptions.ruleExit: an exit the rules trigger at a bar's close is filled at the NEXT bar's open, same no-look-ahead rule as entries.
assumptions.stopsAndTargets: stop = 1.5 x ATR(14) and target = 3.0 x ATR(14), both measured from the trigger bar's mid close, identical to the live engine. Stop/target are treated as exit triggers alongside the rule's own exit (cross against, or trend-filter flip).
assumptions.optimisation: NONE. No parameter search, no sweep, no timeframe search. One ruleset, as documented.
assumptions.r: 1R = the trade's initial stop distance (1.5 x ATR(14) at the trigger bar, in pips).

exclusions: swap / financing / carry charges — NOT modelled
slippage beyond the quoted bid/ask spread — NOT modelled
commission, fees and taxes — NOT modelled
position sizing and account equity — NOT modelled; every result is in pips and R
weekend/holiday gaps are left as gaps; no bar is interpolated or filled in

combinedHeadline.note: Holding time is what decides how much of a trade's cost is swap/financing. Swap is NOT modelled anywhere in this run — these figures exist only to size that omission.

optimisticUpperBound_triggerClose.label: OPTIMISTIC UPPER BOUND — fills at the trigger bar's close, which is only knowable after that bar has ended. NOT achievable in practice.

ruleset.summary: Trend filter EMA(50)/EMA(200); entry on an EMA(20)/EMA(50) cross in the direction of the trend; stop and target sized from ATR(14); exit to flat on a cross against the position or a trend-filter flip.
ruleset.trendFilter: EMA(50) above EMA(200) = uptrend; EMA(50) below EMA(200) = downtrend; exactly equal = no trend.
ruleset.entryTrigger: EMA(20) crossing EMA(50) in the direction of the trend filter. A cross against the trend filter is ignored.
ruleset.entryLevel: The close of the bar the trigger fired on. A reference level on that bar's close — not a filled order and not a bid/ask quote.
ruleset.stop: 1.5 x ATR(14) from the entry, on the losing side (below entry for a long, above for a short).
ruleset.target: 3.0 x ATR(14) from the entry, on the winning side. 1:2 risk:reward by construction.
ruleset.exit: Flat on an EMA(20)/EMA(50) cross against the position, or on the trend filter flipping against it.
ruleset.candles: Closed hourly bars only. Unfinished bars and bars with missing prices are discarded, never filled in.

liveSignalsRaw.disclaimer: These are algorithmic technical signals from the ruleset written down in /home/team/shared/ruleset.md. They are shown for the owner's own reading and decisions. They are not advice, not a recommendation, and not an order — and no performance, accuracy or win rate has been measured for them yet. The bars are hourly broker bars, not a tick quote, and only bars the broker has flagged complete are used. The bid/ask beside each signal is an indicative quote from the owner's own account (practice unless stated) and is shown as a cost input only — it is not a fill, not a tradable guarantee and not a performance figure.
